no-time-off.name: Time off
no-time-off.line: I never get a real break from work.

sources.passage: Paid vacation leave was available to 80 percent of private industry workers
Some 46% of U.S. workers who receive paid time off from their employer
A similar share (49%) say they'd worry about falling behind at work if they took more time off.

no-time-off.prevalence: Paid vacation was available to 80 percent of U.S. private industry workers (BLS). Of workers who get paid time off, 46% take less than they're offered, and 49% of those say they'd worry about falling behind (Pew).

benefits-runaround.name: Benefits
benefits-runaround.line: I have to fight to get or keep the benefits I qualify for.

sources.passage: More than one-third (34%) of all low-income households experienced a problem related to income maintenance

benefits-runaround.prevalence: More than one-third (34%) of low-income U.S. households had a civil legal problem with income maintenance, such as benefits, in the past year (Legal Services Corporation).
